decisive_spans.text: Ultrasound-guided fine-needle aspiration yielded a cystic background with “dirty” necrosis and pseudopapillary clusters of moderately atypical cells with cyanophilic cytoplasm

response.rationale: D3 (Mucoepidermoid carcinoma) is strongly supported by the presence of a cystic lesion with 'dirty' necrosis and pseudopapillary clusters of moderately atypical cells, which are classic features of this diagnosis. The Milan System classification of Category V (suspicious for malignancy) also aligns with this. D1 (Acinic cell carcinoma) is also supported by similar features, but Mucoepidermoid carcinoma is generally more common and the description fits very well. D2 (Pleomorphic adenoma) and D4 (Warthin tumor) are contradicted by the presence of atypical cells and suspicion for malignancy.
